#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Script to reproduce the url_concat issue with None args parameter."""

from tornado.httputil import url_concat

def test_url_concat_with_none():
    """Test that url_concat handles None args parameter gracefully."""
    print("Testing url_concat with None args parameter...")
    
    try:
        # This should cause a crash according to the issue
        url = url_concat("https://localhost/path?r=1&t=2", None)
        print(f"Success: {url}")
        return True
    except TypeError as e:
        print(f"Error occurred: {e}")
        return False

def test_url_concat_with_empty_list():
    """Test that url_concat works with empty list (should work)."""
    print("Testing url_concat with empty list...")
    
    try:
        url = url_concat("https://localhost/path?r=1&t=2", [])
        print(f"Success: {url}")
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error occurred: {e}")
        return False

def test_url_concat_with_empty_dict():
    """Test that url_concat works with empty dict (should work)."""
    print("Testing url_concat with empty dict...")
    
    try:
        url = url_concat("https://localhost/path?r=1&t=2", {})
        print(f"Success: {url}")
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error occurred: {e}")
        return False

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=== Reproducing url_concat issue ===")
    
    # Test the problematic case
    result1 = test_url_concat_with_none()
    
    # Test working cases for comparison
    result2 = test_url_concat_with_empty_list()
    result3 = test_url_concat_with_empty_dict()
    
    print("\n=== Summary ===")
    print(f"url_concat with None: {'PASS' if result1 else 'FAIL'}")
    print(f"url_concat with []: {'PASS' if result2 else 'FAIL'}")
    print(f"url_concat with {{}}: {'PASS' if result3 else 'FAIL'}")

def url_concat(url, args):
    """Concatenate url and arguments regardless of whether
    url has existing query parameters.

    ``args`` may be either a dictionary or a list of key-value pairs
    (the latter allows for multiple values with the same key.

    >>> url_concat("http://example.com/foo", dict(c="d"))
    'http://example.com/foo?c=d'
    >>> url_concat("http://example.com/foo?a=b", dict(c="d"))
    'http://example.com/foo?a=b&c=d'
    >>> url_concat("http://example.com/foo?a=b", [("c", "d"), ("c", "d2")])
    'http://example.com/foo?a=b&c=d&c=d2'
    """
    if args is None:
        return url
    parsed_url = urlparse(url)
    if isinstance(args, dict):
        parsed_query = parse_qsl(parsed_url.query, keep_blank_values=True)
        parsed_query.extend(args.items())
    elif isinstance(args, list) or isinstance(args, tuple):
        parsed_query = parse_qsl(parsed_url.query, keep_blank_values=True)
        parsed_query.extend(args)
    else:
        err = "'args' parameter should be dict, list or tuple. Not {0}".format(
            type(args))
        raise TypeError(err)
    final_query = urlencode(parsed_query)
    url = urlunparse((
        parsed_url[0],
        parsed_url[1],
        parsed_url[2],
        parsed_url[3],
        final_query,
        parsed_url[5]))
    return url

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Comprehensive test for url_concat fix."""

from tornado.httputil import url_concat

def test_comprehensive():
    """Test various scenarios for url_concat."""
    
    test_cases = [
        # (url, args, expected_result, description)
        ("https://localhost/path?r=1&t=2", None, "https://localhost/path?r=1&t=2", "None args should return original URL"),
        ("https://localhost/path?r=1&t=2", [], "https://localhost/path?r=1&t=2", "Empty list should return original URL"),
        ("https://localhost/path?r=1&t=2", {}, "https://localhost/path?r=1&t=2", "Empty dict should return original URL"),
        ("https://localhost/path", [("a", "b")], "https://localhost/path?a=b", "List with one param"),
        ("https://localhost/path", {"a": "b"}, "https://localhost/path?a=b", "Dict with one param"),
        ("https://localhost/path?x=1", [("a", "b")], "https://localhost/path?x=1&a=b", "List with existing params"),
        ("https://localhost/path?x=1", {"a": "b"}, "https://localhost/path?x=1&a=b", "Dict with existing params"),
        ("https://localhost/path", None, "https://localhost/path", "None args with no existing params"),
        ("https://localhost/path#fragment", None, "https://localhost/path#fragment", "None args with fragment"),
        ("https://localhost/path?x=1#fragment", [("y", "2")], "https://localhost/path?x=1&y=2#fragment", "List with existing params and fragment"),
    ]
    
    passed = 0
    failed = 0
    
    for i, (url, args, expected, description) in enumerate(test_cases):
        try:
            result = url_concat(url, args)
            if result == expected:
                print(f"✓ Test {i+1}: {description}")
                passed += 1
            else:
                print(f"✗ Test {i+1}: {description}")
                print(f"  Expected: {expected}")
                print(f"  Got:      {result}")
                failed += 1
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"✗ Test {i+1}: {description}")
            print(f"  Exception: {e}")
            failed += 1
    
    print(f"\n=== Results ===")
    print(f"Passed: {passed}")
    print(f"Failed: {failed}")
    print(f"Total:  {passed + failed}")
    
    return failed == 0

def test_error_cases():
    """Test that invalid args still raise TypeError."""
    print("\n=== Testing Error Cases ===")
    
    error_cases = [
        ("https://localhost/path", "invalid", "String args should raise TypeError"),
        ("https://localhost/path", 123, "Integer args should raise TypeError"),
        ("https://localhost/path", set(), "Set args should raise TypeError"),
    ]
    
    passed = 0
    failed = 0
    
    for i, (url, args, description) in enumerate(error_cases):
        try:
            result = url_concat(url, args)
            print(f"✗ Test {i+1}: {description}")
            print(f"  Expected TypeError but got result: {result}")
            failed += 1
        except TypeError:
            print(f"✓ Test {i+1}: {description}")
            passed += 1
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"✗ Test {i+1}: {description}")
            print(f"  Expected TypeError but got {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
            failed += 1
    
    print(f"\n=== Error Case Results ===")
    print(f"Passed: {passed}")
    print(f"Failed: {failed}")
    print(f"Total:  {passed + failed}")
    
    return failed == 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=== Comprehensive url_concat Testing ===")
    
    success1 = test_comprehensive()
    success2 = test_error_cases()
    
    if success1 and success2:
        print("\n🎉 All tests passed!")
    else:
        print("\n❌ Some tests failed!")

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Test specifically for the None args case to add to the test suite."""

import unittest
from tornado.httputil import url_concat


class TestUrlConcatNoneArgs(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_url_concat_none_args(self):
        """Test that url_concat handles None args parameter gracefully."""
        # Test basic None case
        url = url_concat("https://localhost/path?r=1&t=2", None)
        self.assertEqual(url, "https://localhost/path?r=1&t=2")
        
        # Test None with no existing query params
        url = url_concat("https://localhost/path", None)
        self.assertEqual(url, "https://localhost/path")
        
        # Test None with fragment
        url = url_concat("https://localhost/path?r=1&t=2#fragment", None)
        self.assertEqual(url, "https://localhost/path?r=1&t=2#fragment")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
